hints.content: In order to find $G'(2)$, we should first find an expression for $G'(x)$ (for any input $x$) in terms of $f$, $h$, and their derivatives.

So $G'(x)=f'\Bigl(h(x)\Bigr)\cdot h'(x)$.

We can now plug $x=2$ into this expression and evaluate. Here is the table of values again, for your convenience:

$x$ | $f(x)$ | $h(x)$ | $f'(x)$ | $h'(x)$
:-: | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-:
$-1$ | $9$ | $-1$ | $-5$ | $-6$
$2$ | $3$ | $-1$ | $1$ | $6$

Let's plug in those values!

$\begin{align}
G'(2)&=f'\Bigl(h(2)\Bigr)\cdot h'(2)
\\\\
&=f'(-1)\cdot 6&&\gray{h(2)=-1\text{ , }h'(2)=6}
\\\\
&=-5\cdot 6&&\gray{f'(-1)=-5}
\\\\
&=-30
\end{align}$
